subject: Save subset of parameters in CmdStan

messages.author: a387d7985c232d82
messages.subject: Save subset of parameters in CmdStan
parts:
Hello all,

When using CmdStan, is it possible to save samples of only a subset of the parameters to the output file? I ask because I have a model with lots of ancillary parameters and I would prefer to save only a subset. Thanks for the advice!

Devin

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Save subset of parameters in CmdStan
parts:
Hi Devin,

No, you can't, but local parameters are not saved. You can declare variables within the model block and they won't be saved.


Daniel
